name: ubw-egenmelding
description: Export company-wide egenmelding counts from Unit4/UBW using a connected Chrome session.

interface.shortDescription: Export company-wide egenmelding from UBW using connected Chrome
interface.longDescription: Requires a connected Chrome browser session. Uses Chrome to guide or operate Unit4/UBW, run the Timesheets approved per resource (T2) report, apply Norwegian egenmelding counting rules, and produce CSV outputs without local scripts or browser launchers.
defaultPrompt: Export egenmelding from UBW using Chrome.
Count egenmelding for the last 52 completed weeks.
